linkedin-en.title: Thinking Bridge v5.0.0 — Free Offline Cognitive Transfer App (14 Languages)
linkedin-en.text:
Just shipped Thinking Bridge v5.0.0 — First Official Stable Release.

Built in Alexandria, Egypt for Arabic-speaking STEM students & language learners:
• 100% Offline-First (PWA + Capacitor Android APK + Desktop)
• Zero ads, zero paywalls, unlimited free hearts
• Offline L1 Cognitive Coach + Word-by-Word Diff in Egyptian Arabic & English
• 14 languages, SM-2 spaced repetition, 356 automated tests + 19 E2E checks

Try it live or grab the v5.0.0 APK: https://tb-eg.vercel.app
GitHub: https://github.com/AmrSherifCodes/Arabic-English-Thinking-Bridge/releases/tag/v5.0.0

#OpenSource #EdTech #OfflineFirst #PWA #Android
